about_the_game:
BioSynth: Rising is a classic RPG set in a gripping sci-fi and cyberpunk world where technology and bio-engineering have blurred the lines of humanity.

Explore a Rich World

Immerse yourself in a detailed and atmospheric setting, uncovering its secrets, navigating bustling cityscapes, and venturing into dangerous, uncharted territories.

Explore the world with an isometric view.

Gather Your Party

Recruit a diverse cast of companions, each with their own unique backstories, skills, and motivations. Forge bonds and build a party that complements your playstyle.

During your adventures, you'll meet characters that can be your companions. You can gather a party of up to 4 characters.

Customize Your Builds

Define your characters through a class system and deep skill trees. Experiment with different combinations to create powerful builds and adapt to any challenge.

Currently there are 3 classes in the game (a fourth one is coming soon). Each class has access to 3 skill trees. Each skill tree has 8 active skills that you can cast when playing. It means that there's a total of 24 active skills per class, and you can even pick skills from different trees for max customization.

Gather Powerful Items

Discover a wide array of weapons, armors, and augmentations. Equip your party with the best gear to overcome the dangers that lie ahead.

Some of the weapons will even grant special castable skills to your character.

Engage in Turn-Based Combat

Test your strategic thinking in engaging turn-based battles. Utilize your party's skills and abilities to outmaneuver and defeat fearsome enemies.

During your turn, you'll be able to perform a number of actions, including moving, attacking, casting skills and using items, depending on the number of action points that your character possesses.

Unveil a Rich Story

Delve into a compelling narrative set within a lore-rich world. Uncover the mysteries of BioSynth and the forces shaping its destiny.

Branched dialogs and quests will make you enjoy lots of fascinating stories.

Your Choices Matter

Experience a dynamic story where your decisions have real consequences, shaping the world around you and influencing the fates of your companions.

Thanks to a reputation system and a careful event management, NPC will respond in different ways to you and the world will change, depending on your actions.

BioSynth: Rising offers a nostalgic yet fresh take on the classic RPG formula, blending a captivating story with deep character customization and strategic turn-based combat in a unique sci-fi and cyberpunk setting. Prepare to make choices that will define your journey and the future of BioSynth.
